title: Twilight Yoga Party and Trivia
description: If you love the Twilight Saga AND a good movement class or unique event experience, this one is for you.
long_description:
If you love the Twilight Saga AND a good movement class or unique event experience, this one is for you.

About this Event

We’ll kick things off with a 60-minute yoga class set to the iconic Twilight soundtrack, with a few memorable quotes sprinkled in along the way. Then, put your vampire knowledge to the test with Twilight Saga trivia! Come for the yoga, stay for the nostalgia, and leave with some serious bragging rights. Bring your yoga mat and get ready for a good time!

Also check out other in Indianapolis, Health & Wellness events in Indianapolis, Workshops in Indianapolis.
